================================================================================
Software Requirements Specification
Changes in the Production Cost
12th Dec 2025

# Section 1: Overview

# Purpose
Production cost should be displayed process-wise in the ‘Cost’ tab of the new BOM only if the ‘Enable Process-wise Production Costs’ setting is enabled. Otherwise, it should not be mapped to any process and should be shown as a Other Process Cost.
Scenario 1: When Setting is enabled.
If this setting is enabled then Process wise production Cost should Come
In this screen you can see that production cost is coming process wise.
Scenario 2: When Setting is disabled.
If this setting is disabled then Production Cost should come as an Other Process cost instead of process wise.
In this screen, the production cost is not displayed process-wise; instead, it appears under the generic name 'Other Process'.
PD Query: It should be working for Detached routing, because in case of attached routing system will auto-fetch the data as per the defined process in the routing.
